interface.title: HydroPredict Hyderabad – Hyderabad Ground Water Hydro-Modeling (TimesFM 2.5)
interface.field: Hydrology / groundwater resources (urban water balance, time-series forecasting)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring data and forecasting near-term conditions from historical station records, plus live weather context
interface.what_it_is_for: Compare rainfall, evaporation and net water balance across six Hyderabad groundwater monitoring stations, find monsoon recharge and dry-season depletion periods, and forecast a chosen variable with TimesFM against seasonal and persistence baselines, with a live 10-day ECMWF forecast for context.

data.note: Station records from a bundled Excel file: six CGWHYD stations, daily data from Jan 2022 to late 2025. The ECMWF tab fetched live Open-Meteo data successfully for two stations. The map's basemap tiles never rendered and no station markers were visible; only the colour scale showed. The TimesFM model never finished loading (it needs a Hugging Face download), so no backtest or forecast output was seen.
